Solid concept with the daily levels and the sweep, but there's a structural issue with the mechanical 3-candle entry.

Entering on the breakout of that third candle usually means you are buying the exact top of the first impulse (Wave 1). That's why so many people end up sitting through hours of stressful drawdown or getting stopped out just before the real move happens. The market needs to pull back to fill orders.

A simple tweak to avoid this: Instead of rushing into the breakout, let that first impulse finish, grab your Fib tool, and set a limit order at the deep discount (78.6% - 88.6% retracement). You get a much better entry price, a tighter stop loss, and completely skip the headache of holding a negative float...
